Grafana

标准答案

数据源配置

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: grafana-datasources
data:
  prometheus.yaml: |
    apiVersion: 1
    datasources:
    - name: Prometheus
      type: prometheus
      url: http://prometheus:9090
      isDefault: true
      access: proxy

Dashboard 示例

{
  "dashboard": {
    "title": "Application Metrics",
    "panels": [
      {
        "title": "Request Rate",
        "type": "graph",
        "targets": [
          {
            "expr": "sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (service)"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
